title: Temporal observability of intraoperative hypotension with emulated intermittent blood pressure display: reproducibility package
description: Analysis code, configuration template, reproducibility manifests, figure source data, programmatically generated figures, a final workbook, and non-identifiable aggregate outputs for a temporal-observability study with exploratory postoperative AKI and ICU resource-use analyses. Source datasets and patient-level data are not redistributed. The observational analyses do not estimate a causal effect of monitoring frequency.
